The claimed knee-link geometry is not the part the model's docstring describes. JogModel's docstring and the design notes call the knee link 'a bent 3 mm bar ... one straight ramp <= 60 deg'; the verifier measured the claimed step 3.19 mm over a 13.26 mm ramp run (13.5 deg), and a 3 mm bar with the user's 15 mm inner bend radius rises at most 2.78 mm there (bent_bar_ok false). The CAD ruling allows a tighter transition only on a part machined from solid, stated on the part; the row's re-dispatch record says 'machined Ti knee link' but the mechanism record (mechanism.notes, custom_parts) and the model docstring do not. If it were built as a bent bar the step loses 0.41 mm, which is twice the 0.20 mm pin-a running gap the claim relies on (NEW-tolcliff): unmeasured. Not gamed: a machined knee link exists at this size and costs no joint or complexity point.
